# Kenney Blocky Characters

This folder contains one runtime character asset from Kenney's **Blocky Characters** pack.

- Source: https://www.kenney.nl/assets/blocky-characters
- Runtime asset: `character-b.glb`
- Texture folder: `Textures/`
- License: Creative Commons CC0
- Local license file: `License.txt`

Only the selected GLB is included to keep the portfolio lightweight. The full source pack also includes FBX, OBJ, previews, and additional character variants.
